description: Kansas LIEAP provides a one-time annual heating benefit to eligible households. The 2026 application period has ended; DCF has not yet announced the next opening.
introduction: Kansas LIEAP provides a one-time annual heating benefit to eligible households. The 2026 application period has ended; DCF has not yet announced the next opening.

sections.who: An adult at the address must be responsible for heating costs paid to a landlord, utility or fuel supplier. DCF reviews combined household income and other conditions during the application period.
sections.get: The benefit pays part of home heating costs, including eligible electricity, gas, propane or other heating fuels.
sections.docs: Use the season’s checklist for income and heating bills. DCF requires signatures from all adults living in the residence.
sections.apply:
1. Check DCF’s LIEAP page for the next announced application window. Do not use an old closing date as a current deadline.

  2. When applications reopen, use the DCF portal or request a paper form at the local Service Center. For immediate utility trouble, contact the supplier and ask about payment arrangements or other local aid.
sections.after: Read the decision and verify how assistance is credited. Ask the utility about Cold Weather Rule conditions rather than assuming protection happens automatically.

faqs: Can I apply now in October 2026?
DCF says the 2026 period ended and the next opening will be announced.
Can heating paid through rent qualify?
The eligibility page includes responsibility for heating costs payable to a landlord.
DCF describes a one-time annual benefit.
Does it cover the entire energy bill?
No. It helps with a portion.
